title: The Great Catch of Fish
description: After a fruitless night, Simon Peter casts his nets at Jesus' word and catches an enormous amount of fish. Jesus calls him to become a fisher of men.

versions.reason: [major] references: The story overlaps with 'the-call-of-the-first-disciples', which covers the same Luke 5:1-11, but this proposal focuses specifically on the miraculous catch of fish rather than the general calling of the disciples.
